clue.text: The implication about the German IS "not straight"

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: the implication of a remark is its meaning
der is the German word for the

explanation.surface: A pedant insists that some German phrase's implication is that something is not straight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container indicator. 'IS' is a link word, and the definition is the quoted phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A winding river or path that wanders rather than going direct is said to meander.

clue.text: Greek character with the heartless mum

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: heartless asks for the middle letter of the word the to be dropped

explanation.surface: A Greek figure accompanied by an unfeeling mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' removes the middle H from THE to leave TE. 'Mum' is the definition, as in 'keep mum', not a mother.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep mum is to stay silent, saying nothing at all.

clue.text: Calculating but genuine about bearing up

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the second piece sits within the first

parts.note: genuine means actual, real

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a person's bearing is their air or manner

explanation.surface: Someone shrewd yet sincere is said to be on the rise.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' turns the bearing backwards; 'about' wraps the genuine word round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Actuarial work is the statistical reckoning of risk for insurers, a kind of calculation.

clue.text: A little model highly regarded in India

definitions.note: a place located in India, the clue's phrase standing for a city there

indicators.note: a little of the phrase model highly signals that a short run of its letters is taken

explanation.surface: A small model enjoys a high reputation in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A little' takes a run from the middle of 'model highly'. 'regarded' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital region of India, home to New Delhi, the national seat of government.

clue.text: Grieved-so long in the red

indicators.note: in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
to long for something is to pine for it

explanation.surface: Someone mourns because they yearn so much while being in debt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container indicator; 'in the red' suggests debt in the surface, and 'so' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To repine is to fret or complain in sorrow, a dated way of grieving.

clue.text: They're steely-eyed

parts.note: steely-eyed suggests hard-staring people, but it means made of steel and having an eye, as sewing tools do

explanation.definitionFit: Sewing implements are slender steel shafts each pierced with a small hole for thread.

clue.text: Some keep icily cool, being heroic

indicators.note: some of the phrase keep icily signals that only part of its letters are used

explanation.surface: A stoic who stays perfectly composed is admired as brave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes a run straddling 'keep icily'.
explanation.definitionFit: An epic is a long poem about great deeds, so the word also describes grand, valiant acts.

clue.text: Quietly increase force

parts.note: p, for piano, is the musical direction for quietly
a rise is an increase, as in pay

explanation.surface: Gently turn up the pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To prise something open is to lever it apart with effort.

clue.text: Having read notes on fishing tackle, fish

parts.note: to con is an old word for reading or studying carefully
G and E are both musical notes
reels are part of an angler's tackle

explanation.surface: An angler, having studied the instructions on their gear, catches something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just places the notes before the reels.
explanation.definitionFit: These are large sea creatures resembling snakes, caught by anglers off rocky coasts.

clue.text: Returning soldiers no minister backs give up

indicators.note: in a down clue returning means the word is read backwards, bottom to top

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
taken as written

indicators.note: backs here means the word goes backwards

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a minister of religion

explanation.surface: Soldiers coming home, with no clergyman supporting them, surrender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returning' turns GIS into SIG; 'backs' turns REV into VER.
explanation.definitionFit: To sign over property is to transfer it formally, relinquishing it to another.

clue.text: Add a pound, that's all

parts.note: to tot up is to add figures together
L stands for a pound, from the Latin libra

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper adds one pound to the bill, and that's the end.
explanation.definitionFit: The total is the whole amount, everything counted together.

clue.text: Setting no price is wrong -vagueness is out!

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of the phrase are in the wrong order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that refusing to fix a price is unclear and mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setting' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Exactness and accuracy are the opposite of vagueness, so where they reign it is banished.

clue.text: Grand race of people

definitions.meaning: the Grand ..., a famous British steeplechase run at Aintree
belonging to a whole nation or country's people

explanation.definitionFit: The Grand National is Britain's best-known horse race over fences; as an adjective the word means relating to a country's population.

clue.text: Accurate about a point -—it's all relative!

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: nice can mean precise or accurate, as in a nice distinction
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Being precise about a detail, someone shrugs that it's all a matter of perspective.
explanation.walkthrough: Nice in the old sense of fine or exact. 'it's all relative!' plays on the saying; only 'relative' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A brother's or sister's daughter is a family member.

clue.text: Sailors start lashing in a beam seen slipping

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed among the others
slipping suggests the letters slide out of their order and are rearranged
the start of the word lashing is its first letter

explanation.surface: Sailors begin tying things down while a beam is seen sliding about the deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slipping' rearranges A BEAM SEEN into ABESEAMEN; 'start' takes L, and 'in' puts it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: These are qualified seamen in the Royal Navy or merchant fleet, ranked above ordinary seamen.

clue.text: Taking ship with a desperado

parts.note: a brig is a two-masted sailing ship
and can mean with, as in bread and butter

explanation.surface: A reckless outlaw commandeers a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandit or outlaw who lives by robbery, especially in mountains or forests.

clue.text: A candidate wants partisan constituents

indicators.note: constituents are the component letters of the word partisan, to be reordered

explanation.surface: A political hopeful seeks supporters among the voters of the constituency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents' looks like voters but signals that the letters of 'partisan' are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who aspires to a post or honour is a hopeful seeking selection.

clue.text: A five in black may be set aside

indicators.note: in means these letters are placed inside the other word

parts.note: sable is black in heraldry
V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: A five of spades in a black suit can be kept back in a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A and V inside SABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be rescued or kept for later can be saved.

clue.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

definitions.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

parts.words: An old missile that's making a comeback
parts.note: sounds like a revived weapon, but describes a thrown weapon that literally flies back to the thrower

explanation.definitionFit: A curved throwing stick of Australian origin that returns in flight, used for hunting.

clue.text: Block cut in points

indicators.note: in means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: E, S and E are compass points
to clip is to cut or trim

explanation.surface: A barber trims a hair at the tips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container indicator: the cut goes between the compass points.
explanation.definitionFit: To obscure or overshadow something is to shut it out, as the moon does the sun.

clue.text: Former Palestinian group joins soldiers in making search

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
the PLO is the Palestine Liberation Organization
RE, the Royal Engineers, is a British army corps

explanation.surface: An ex-member of a militant group teams up with troops on a hunt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joins' and 'in making' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: To explore is to investigate or scout an area thoroughly, looking for something.

clue.text: Transport record prepared by a writer of fiction

parts.note: a car is a means of transport
a roll is an official list or record, as in an electoral roll

explanation.surface: A vehicle log compiled by a novelist.
explanation.walkthrough: Lewis Carroll wrote Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll was the Victorian author of the Alice books.

clue.text: A Highlander whose concern is growing

definitions.text: A Highlander whose concern is growing

parts.words: A Highlander whose concern is growing
parts.note: sounds like a Scot with mounting worries, but the concern is a small farm and the growing is of crops

explanation.definitionFit: A tenant of a smallholding in the Scottish Highlands who farms it.

clue.text: For the monarch, right or wrong

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the monarch's cipher
taken as written

explanation.surface: Whether the queen is right or wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A mistake is something done incorrectly.

clue.text: Gathered together when so inclined

definitions.meaning: collected into a heap, as leaves with a garden tool
sloping, as a stage or ship's mast tilted at an angle

explanation.definitionFit: Leaves are collected with a toothed tool; a theatre stage built at a slant is described the same way.

clue.text: The person making an offer of support rose unsteadily

parts.note: a prop is a support

indicators.note: unsteadily suggests the letters wobble and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A suitor offering support got up shakily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsteadily' rearranges ROSE into OSER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who puts forward a motion or a marriage suggestion.

clue.text: OK as a substitute for port in Japan

indicators.note: substitute suggests replacing the order of the letters with another arrangement

explanation.surface: Accepting a replacement harbour in Japan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as a substitute for' reads naturally, but only 'substitute' signals the rearrangement of OK AS A.
explanation.definitionFit: A major Japanese city and seaport on Honshu.

clue.text: Hardy girl, upset, over bearing

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means the word is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: set means finished or over, as the sun is set when the day is over
S, south, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A tough girl gets upset over her posture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns SET into TES. Thomas Hardy wrote Tess of the d'Urbervilles.
explanation.definitionFit: Tess Durbeyfield is the heroine of a Thomas Hardy novel.

clue.text: Pretending to be discerning

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both falsely claiming something and managing to perceive it.

clue.text: Pop into one with all speed

indicators.note: into means one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
pa and pop are both words for father

explanation.surface: Drop in on someone in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' is the container indicator; 'one' is a playing card, not a number to write as I.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving quickly, at a rapid pace.

clue.text: Out of gear

parts.note: sounds like a car not engaged, but means out of one's clothing, gear being clothes

explanation.definitionFit: Naked, wearing no clothes at all.

clue.text: Resorts parents without a file

indicators.note: without means outside, so one word surrounds the other

parts.note: to parent is to raise or rear children
a range is a row or line, like a file

explanation.surface: Parents go on holiday to resorts without packing a nail file.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resorts' reads as holiday places but is re-sorts, puts in order again. 'without' is the old sense outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To sort again is to put back into a fresh order.
